scenario: A rule may `withdraw` a fault fact it matched (LSCP.2.6.1, LERR.9.5): the `internal` scope is admitted beside `explicit` by the withdraw-scope check (LSCO.4.5.9), where any other non-explicit scope is DS_VALIDATE_WITHDRAW_SCOPE. Positive half of LSCP.2.6.1_internal_emit.
rules_ds:
rule handler:
    ComputationError e
->
    log info "{e.kind}"
    withdraw e
